tree: Every number above comes from these lines. Change any input and you can follow it through.

tree.className: rounded-[var(--radius-large)] border border-[var(--color-stroke-default)] bg-[var(--color-bg-card)] p-6 transition-colors duration-200 flex flex-col gap-4

tree:
break_fix  = breaks × hours_per_fix × coe_rate × 12
exceptions = exceptions × (minutes ÷ 60) × ops_rate × 12
total      = license_and_infra + break_fix + exceptions
per_bot    = total ÷ production_bots
outside    = (break_fix + exceptions) ÷ total
Not included: change and governance work (re-testing, access reviews, audit evidence). If you track it, add it to the license line.

tree: Turn the estimate into a fact base
The Bot Estate Audit builds a fragility score and run-cost model from your own logs, in two weeks. If the exception line is your biggest, a 2-week Sprint shows how much an agent can clear.
